name: Hana Yori Dango -Koi Seyo Otome!-
original_name: 花より男子 －恋せよ女子（おとめ）!－
source:
Hanayori Dango is a modern, comical retelling of the Cinderella tale that has captured the hearts of many shoujo manga lovers. The series have been made into an anime, several live action series and feature length films. Now this romantic comedy becomes available to the gamers.

Koi Seyo Otome is a dating simulation adventure where you become one of the "commoner" students enrolled into Eitoku, the school for celebrities. Befriend you fellow commoner, Tsukushi and the F4 members.

The F4s are the blue bloods amongst the celebrity kids in school, although their king Doumeishi ended up with Tsukushi in the manga, in this game, you are the protagonist, so feel free to pursue anyone you wish.

The game is split into morning, noon and nights, get ready for school in the morning and make sure you look good as you are going to meet the F4s. Go ahead and bump into them during school time and score lunch dates or get their email addresses. Make use of these contacts and ask them to dates at night.

Increase your affection level with them during dates, know their favourite pasttimes and cater to them and you will have them wrapped around your little finger.

[From [url=http://www.dcemu.co.uk/vbulletin/threads/119184-Hanayori-Danshi-Koi-Seyo-Onago"]dcemu.co.uk[/url]]
translation:
《花样男子》以现代喜剧风格重新演绎了灰姑娘的故事，俘获了许多少女漫画爱好者的心。该系列已被改编成动画、多部真人剧集和长篇电影，如今，这部浪漫喜剧也来到了玩家面前。

《恋爱吧少女！》是一款恋爱模拟冒险游戏。玩家将成为英德学园这所名流学校中的一名“平民”学生，与同为平民的杉菜及F4成员结识。

F4是校内名流子弟中的贵族。漫画中，他们的首领道明寺最终与杉菜走到了一起，但在本作里，你才是主人公，可以自由追求任何心仪对象。

游戏的一天分为早晨、中午和夜晚。早晨做好上学准备，并务必精心打扮，因为你将与F4见面。上学时可以设法与他们偶遇，争取共进午餐的约会，或拿到他们的电子邮箱地址；晚上则可利用这些联系方式邀他们外出。

在约会中提高他们对你的好感，了解并迎合各自的喜好，你便能让他们拜倒在自己脚下。

[摘自[url=http://www.dcemu.co.uk/vbulletin/threads/119184-Hanayori-Danshi-Koi-Seyo-Onago"]dcemu.co.uk[/url]]
